installed=1 means ModSecurity is installed and 0 means it is not installed. This payload flag is separate from the UAPI success status; omitted installed remains absent.

On 11.138.0.19, hasModsecurityInstalled() and listDomains() failed when the selected account lacked the modsecurity feature. With that feature enabled on a disposable account, both reads passed through direct UAPI and the WHM bridge. This is an account-state capability observation, not a universal route limitation.

evidence.note: Pinned /ModSecurity/has_modsecurity_installed GET declares x-readonly=true. Preserve the read-only GET. Preserve the inline data schema and optional field presence; enabled and installed, where present, are integer 0/1 flags.

Reviewer 5720388941 attributes the existing read failures to missing account feature modsecurity. Enabling it only for the disposable test account made hasModsecurityInstalled and listDomains pass on both routes. Existing artifacts retain their original failed outcomes; no recapture or client capability override is implied.
